id: \bAh, it's you!
en: \bAh, it's you!

id: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!

en: \bYour Pokémon was holding an Egg!
it: \bIl tuo Pokémon aveva con sé un Uovo!

en: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.

en: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
